title: England, Approved Document M
edition: Approved Document M Vol 1 (2015 incorporating 2016 amendments), M4(1); Vol 2 (2015 with 2020 and 2024 amendments), Diagram 18
notes: Vol 2 values are read from Diagram 18 (the unisex wheelchair-accessible toilet). Ambulant cubicles (Diagram 21, 920 × 1465 mm since 2024) are not yet in this pack.

zones.id: AD M Vol 1 M4(1) WC access zone
zones.description: WC access zone 750 mm deep in front of the pan, 450 mm either side of the centreline for a frontal transfer; a basin must not project into it so as to impede access

zones.id: AD M Vol 2 Diagram 18 transfer space
zones.description: At least 1000 mm clear from the WC centreline to the transfer-side wall, beside the pan (front of the pan 750 mm from the rear wall)
A 1500 mm deep manoeuvring space in front of lockers in changing facilities

distances.description: WC centreline 500 mm from the side wall

falls.description: A wet room's shower area falls at least 1:80 to its drain, 1:60 commonly, 1:40 at most outside the drain's collar

waterproofing.description: A level-access shower makes its room a wet room: the whole floor tanked, and the shower's walls to 1.8 m
